notes.title: Release Date Set for March 20, 2025
notes.notes:
I'm Kajinoyu.

We have officially set the release date for Me and (My) Cat's Island to March 20, 2025.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2703970/_/

In preparation for the release, we have also published a new trailer.
Please check it out if you're interested!

[previewyoutube=Vlp7_isDyd4;full]https://youtu.be/Vlp7_isDyd4?si=xFJ8AcktS1QK36Kw[/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Regarding the release date
notes.notes:
I'm Kajinoyu.

We have decided to postpone the release of “Me and (My) Cat's Island” from December 2024 to sometime in 2025. I’m sorry.

I’ll do my best to have it ready for release as early as possible next year!
